author: Knacksters
name: Cirklu extension
description: Zero-exposure API key manager. Local AES-256 encryption, autofill, and secure sharing. Keys never leave your device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.cirklu.com ws://localhost:* wss://localhost:* https://www.googleapis.com https://oauth2.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com https://api.dropboxapi.com https://content.dropboxapi.com https://*.cloudfunctions.net; frame-src https://accounts.google.com https://*.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
